resources.string: Run a full rootless Debian Linux desktop on Android with GPU acceleration and Wayland display support.
Download, verify, and extract the Debian ARM64 root filesystem into app storage.
Your Linux environment is ready. Start the Wayland display session to enter LodOS.
Android may stop background Linux processes or the LodOS session. Review these device settings for a more reliable session.
No extra background restrictions were detected.
Android 12 and newer limit background child processes. On Android 14+, open Developer options and enable “Disable child process restrictions” if available. This can increase battery and memory use.
Android child-process monitoring appears disabled. If guest processes are still stopped, review Developer options.
Allow LodOS to ignore battery optimization so Android is less likely to stop its foreground session. You can change this later in system settings.
In Security or Battery settings, enable Autostart for LodOS and set its battery use to “No restrictions” when available. Names vary by MIUI / HyperOS version.
Advanced optional ADB tip: adb shell settings put global settings_enable_monitor_phantom_procs 0. This changes a device-wide developer setting; use only if you understand the trade-offs.
